FAIL_TO_PASS: preload-module: allows pre-loading modules via this.load
warn-import-export: warns about import and export related issues
manual-chunks-info: provides additional chunk information to a manualChunks function
plugin-module-information: provides module information on the plugin context
named-import-external: warns when a conflicting binding is imported via a named import from external namespaces
module-parsed-hook: calls the moduleParsedHook once a module is parsed
